terminos.title: Terms of Use — NX-Studio
terminos.description: Terms and conditions governing the use of this site and the contracting of services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using this website (nx-studio.nx-studio.workers.dev) and contracting NX-Studio services, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the site or contract our services.

sections.title: 2. Services Offered
sections.content: NX-Studio offers custom software development services: web applications, mobile apps, SaaS, applied AI, automations, testing & QA, and purchasable templates. Scope, price, and timelines are defined in each accepted quote.

sections.title: 3. Contracting Process
sections.content: 1) Client requests a quote via /cotizador or WhatsApp. 2) NX-Studio delivers a quote with scope, price, timelines, and conditions. 3) Client accepts the quote (email/WhatsApp). 4) Service order or simple contract is signed. 5) Start with initial payment (50% typical). 6) Deliveries by milestones + final payment upon delivery.

sections.title: 4. Pricing and Payments
sections.content: Prices are quoted in COP (Colombia) or USD (international). Market research ranges 2025-2026. Payment to operator's personal account (Nequi, Bancolombia, Stripe Connect in their name). NX-Studio does NOT process automated payments. DIAN electronic invoice issued upon payment.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.content: Code and deliverables become client property upon full payment. NX-Studio retains rights over proprietary frameworks, libraries, and methodology. Third-party licenses (open source libraries) respected per their license.

sections.title: 6. Confidentiality
sections.content: NX-Studio signs NDA upon client request. Sensitive information (credentials, business data, code) is handled under strict confidentiality and deleted post-project unless otherwise agreed.

sections.title: 7. Warranties and Liability
sections.content: We deliver functional code per agreed spec. Critical bugs fixed at no cost within 30 days post-delivery. No warranty on business results (sales, users, ROI). Liability limited to contract value.

sections.title: 8. Termination
sections.content: Either party may terminate with written notice. Work performed to date is paid proportionally. Code delivered to date is handed over to client.

sections.title: 9. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
sections.content: Laws of the Republic of Colombia. Jurisdiction: Courts of Neiva, Huila. For international clients, jurisdiction agreed in contract.

sections.title: 10. Changes to Terms
sections.content: NX-Studio may update these terms. Material changes notified by email/WhatsApp with 30 days notice. Continued use implies acceptance.

privacidad.title: Privacy Policy — NX-Studio
privacidad.description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.content: NX-Studio (Sebastian Velasco Ocampo), Neiva, Huila, Colombia. Contact: sebasvelascodev3101@gmail.com · WhatsApp +57 310 331 2705.

sections.title: 2. Data We Collect
sections.content:
• Contact data: name, email, phone, company (from /cotizador form, newsletter, contact).
• Navigation data: IP, user-agent, path, referrer, UTM, locale (analytics beacon).
• Chat data: messages in AI lab and SophIA chatbot.
• Technical data: IP, user-agent, headers (audit log, security).

sections.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis
sections.content:
• Quote/service: contract performance / legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.b/f GDPR).
• Newsletter: explicit consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR).
• Analytics: legitimate interest (site improvement, Art. 6.1.f GDPR).
• Security/audit: legal obligation / legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.c/f GDPR).

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your data. We share only with: Resend (transactional email), Cloudflare (hosting/WAF/analytics), better-auth (auth), Deriv (trading bot, only if you contract that service). All under DPA/SCCs.

sections.title: 5. International Transfers
sections.content: Servers on Cloudflare (US/global). Resend (US). Transfers under SCCs (Standard Contractual Clauses) and adequacy decisions where applicable.

sections.title: 6. Retention
sections.content:
• Quotes/leads: 3 years post-last interaction (Art. 17 GDPR).
• Newsletter: until voluntary unsubscribe (unsubscribe link in every email).
• Analytics events: 13 months (automated purge job).
• Audit logs: 3 years (compliance, security).
• AI chat: 2 years (model improvement, anonymized).

sections.title: 7. User Rights (GDPR Arts. 15-22)
sections.content: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection. Exercise: email sebasvelascodev3101@gmail.com or WhatsApp +57 310 331 2705. Response within ≤ 30 days.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.content: TLS 1.3 in transit. Cloudflare WAF + Rate Limiting + Turnstile. Headers CSP/HSTS/X-Frame. Secrets in Cloudflare Secrets (not in repo). Code and dependency audit (npm audit).

sections.title: 9. Cookies and Tracking
sections.content: See Cookie Policy. Only strictly necessary cookies (session, CSRF, language preference, cookie consent). Server-side analytics beacon (no cookies). No marketing cookies without consent.

sections.title: 10. DPO Contact
sections.content: Sebastian Velasco Ocampo (DPO). sebasvelascodev3101@gmail.com · WhatsApp +57 310 331 2705.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy — NX-Studio
cookies.description: What cookies we use, for what purpose, and how to manage them.

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Small text files your browser stores on your device to remember preferences, session, and measure site usage.

sections.title: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
sections.content:
• Strictly necessary (always on): session (better-auth), CSRF, language preference, cookie consent. Without these the site does not work.
• Analytics (optional, requires consent): page events, UTM, referrer, server-side beacon. No third-party cookies.
• Functional (optional): UI preferences (theme, layout).
• Marketing: We do NOT use marketing/third-party cookies.

sections.title: 3. How to Manage Consent
sections.content: Cookie banner on first visit. You can accept all, only necessary, or customize. Change preferences anytime via 'Cookies' link in footer.

sections.title: 4. Cookie Details
sections.content: These are the cookies NX-Studio uses today. We do not use marketing or third-party cookies.

sections.title: 5. How to Disable/Delete
sections.content: Browser → Settings → Cookies → Delete site data (nx-studio.nx-studio.workers.dev). Or use 'Manage cookies' link in footer.

sections.title: 6. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: Updates posted here with date. Material changes notified via site banner.

chatbot.title: SophIA
chatbot.subtitle: NX-Studio virtual assistant
chatbot.help_text:
Available commands:
• /help — show this help
• /reset — clear the conversation
• /portalsignup — go to the client portal

You can also ask me in Spanish, English or Portuguese about pricing, services, templates, the lab or contact info.
chatbot.reset_done: Conversation reset. How can I help?
chatbot.portalsignup: Taking you to the client portal in a new tab. If you don't have an account yet, you can create one when you arrive.
chatbot.mock_greeting: Hi! I'm SophIA, NX-Studio's virtual assistant. If you can imagine it, you can create it. How can I help today? Ask me about pricing, services, templates, or type /help for commands.
chatbot.mock_pricing: Based on real market research (Colombia 2025-2026 + international): landing $500K–$1.5M COP ($1.5K–$8K USD); corporate site + blog $1.2M–$3M COP ($2.5K–$12K USD); e-commerce $2.5M–$20M COP ($5K–$60K USD); web app/SaaS $10M–$50M COP ($15K–$100K USD); mobile app $4M–$40M COP ($10K–$80K USD); AI/chatbot $2M–$15M COP ($5K–$40K USD). No project is free: even a blog costs design, development, domain and hosting. For your exact quote open the calculator (/cotizador) or tell me what you need.
chatbot.mock_handoff: I'll connect you with the human team. Meanwhile, tell me about your project in 2-3 lines and we'll speed up the first contact. Typical response in under 24 business hours.
chatbot.mock_unknown: I'm not sure I understood. I can help with pricing, services, templates, the lab or handing you off to a human. Try /help for commands.
chatbot.mock_services: We build: custom web development, mobile apps, applied AI (chatbots, RAG, agents), automations & integrations (WhatsApp Cloud, payment gateways), SaaS products, e-commerce & marketplaces, testing & QA, software security, UI/UX & design systems, data & BI, cloud & DevOps, legacy migrations, maintenance & support, consulting & architecture, buyable templates and technical SEO. Which one interests you? Quote any of them at /cotizador.
chatbot.mock_templates: We have production-ready templates (landing, dashboard, e-commerce) ready to buy and deploy. MIT-licensed, no royalties, support during the first sprint. Head over to /templates to see the catalog.
chatbot.mock_labs: The AI lab is where we experiment with mockup generation, agents and prototypes. No backend, all in your browser. If you want to see one live, /laboratorio.
chatbot.mock_contact: For direct contact: form at /contacto (saves to backend and notifies the team), or /cotizador for an immediate estimate. Also /portalsignup if you prefer to create an account on the portal.
chatbot.mock_thanks: You're welcome! If you need anything else, I'm right here.
chatbot.empty_state: Start the conversation with a greeting or /help to see commands.
chatbot.footer_disclaimer: SophIA is an automated assistant. Responses are indicative; the team confirms any formal proposal.
